title: Fix Flow Context Menu
description: Unify declarative context-menu specs end-to-end (icons, colors, hover previews, full item sets), fix host mapping that strips richness, and fill incomplete menus in flow, puzzle, and every other app.
summary: Unified declarative ContextMenuItemSpec end-to-end: UI supports color swatches, hover, and submenus; hosts map full specs; suggestions use the same controller with per-kind colors on candidates and brush ghosts; flow emits rich menus (add/select-all/reorganize/hide-show preview/delete) with preview_off runtime; puzzle 2d/3d/5d and other node-graph apps emit icons, separators, and destructive delete; vortex menus include suggest plus zoom/delete. Verified via vitest and cargo tests; [DEBUG] logs on menu open and hoverSuggestion.
